/products/sd-wan.title: ScaleAOn SD-WAN — Enterprise WAN Platform · Lavelle Networks
main: Connect every branch, data centre, and cloud workload through intelligent, application-aware WAN infrastructure designed for large distributed enterprises.
Distributed enterprises are operating WAN infrastructure that was designed before cloud-first architectures, hybrid work, and multi-link connectivity became standard requirements.
Managing multiple ISP links with no intelligent path selection
Application performance degradation during link failures
IT teams spending weeks deploying each new branch
No centralised visibility across distributed WAN
Excessive MPLS costs with no flexibility to adopt broadband
Application-aware routing across broadband, MPLS, 4G, and 5G simultaneously — traffic always takes the best available path based on real-time link conditions.
Deploy new branches without sending specialised engineers on-site. Pre-configured edge devices connect automatically the moment they are powered on.
Automatic failover maintains application uptime when any individual link degrades. No manual intervention required to restore connectivity.
Compression, deduplication, and QoS policies reduce bandwidth consumption and ensure business-critical applications always receive priority treatment.
Apply and enforce network policies across all sites from one console. Consistent configuration without per-device manual work.
Full-stack WAN telemetry with application-level performance dashboards. Know the health of every link and application across every branch at all times.
Ship pre-configured ScaleAOn appliances to each branch location. Zero-touch provisioning means no specialist engineer is needed on-site.
All sites connect automatically through encrypted tunnels to the ScaleAOn controller, forming a secure, managed WAN fabric.
Application traffic is continuously monitored and steered across the best available path — broadband, MPLS, 4G, or 5G — in real time.
IT operations teams get unified visibility and policy control through a single centralised dashboard, with alerts and telemetry across the entire WAN.
Deploy new branches in hours, not weeks
Zero-touch provisioning eliminates on-site engineering requirements. Ship a device, power it on, and the branch is live.
Maintain application performance across all links
Intelligent path control adapts to real-time network conditions so application experience does not depend on any single link.
Reduce WAN costs without sacrificing reliability
Add broadband and 4G links alongside or in place of costly MPLS circuits and retain full resilience through multi-path failover.

/products/sase.title: indusWall SASE — Cloud-Native Network Security · Lavelle Networks
main: Converge SD-WAN, Zero Trust, and cloud security into one platform that protects every user, branch, and cloud workload — without the complexity of multiple point products.
Security has to move with your users.

Enterprise workforces are distributed across branches, homes, and cloud platforms. Traditional perimeter-based security cannot follow them — and trying to force it creates performance problems and policy gaps.
Remote and hybrid workforce accessing corporate applications over untrusted networks
Security policies inconsistently applied across branches and cloud workloads
Multiple point-product security vendors with no unified visibility
MPLS-backhauled internet traffic creating latency and performance issues
Growing threat surface from SaaS adoption and cloud migration
Inspect and filter all web and internet traffic across every user and branch. Block malware, enforce acceptable-use policies, and gain full visibility into web activity.
Identity-aware access policies ensure users only reach authorised applications — never the broader network. Access is evaluated continuously, not just at login.
Visibility and control over SaaS application usage and data movement. Prevent data exfiltration and enforce compliance policies across cloud workloads.
Cloud-delivered firewall policies applied consistently across branches and users — without deploying physical appliances at every location.
Secure direct internet access from branches without backhauling traffic to a central datacenter. Users get cloud performance; security teams get full inspection.
One console for networking and security policies across all users, branches, and cloud workloads. Remove the operational overhead of managing multiple disconnected tools.
Connect through the indusWall security fabric
Users and branches establish connections through the indusWall cloud security fabric — a globally distributed set of security enforcement points.
Before any application access is granted, identity and device posture are verified. Zero Trust policies are evaluated in real time for every session.
All traffic is inspected through SWG, CASB, and FWaaS policy engines simultaneously — providing layered protection without adding latency.
Every connection, user, and policy decision is visible in real time through a single operations console. Respond to threats and policy violations immediately.
Cloud-delivered policies apply equally to branches, remote users, and mobile devices. There is no perimeter to bypass.
Direct cloud and internet access with inline security, without routing all traffic through central datacentres. Users experience lower latency and better application performance.
Replace multiple point-security products with one converged SASE platform. Fewer vendors means lower cost, less complexity, and faster incident response.

main: CloudPort Edge devices deploy at enterprise locations of any size, providing the WAN connectivity, application intelligence, and local policy enforcement that powers the ScaleAOn platform.

Every enterprise location runs a CloudPort Edge instance. It provides local WAN connectivity, enforces application policies, monitors link quality, and connects the branch to the broader ScaleAOn network through encrypted tunnels to the CloudPort Gateway.
Connect across broadband, MPLS, 4G/LTE, and 5G links simultaneously from any enterprise location. No single transport dependency.
Classify and route application traffic based on type, priority, and link quality in real time. Business-critical applications always receive the treatment they require.
Continuously measure link quality and automatically shift traffic to the best available path. Degraded links are avoided before users notice any impact.
Pre-configure devices before shipping. Site teams plug in and the device self-provisions without specialised networking knowledge or on-site engineers.
Apply security policies at the branch level, including firewall, access control, and segmentation capabilities — consistently enforced from central policy.
Stream continuous performance data to CloudStation Insights for visibility, analytics, and AI-powered operations across every edge location.
CloudPort Edge is available as a physical appliance, virtual appliance, or cloud instance. Organisations can mix deployment types across locations to match each site's infrastructure requirements.
Rack or desktop form factors for branch offices of varying sizes. Sized for small satellite offices through large regional enterprise locations.

Combine multiple WAN links into logical bonded connections for increased aggregate throughput and transport-level resilience without application impact.
Active-active or active-standby gateway configurations ensure continuous operation. Failover occurs automatically without requiring manual intervention.
Automatically reroute traffic during data-centre failover or disaster-recovery events, maintaining enterprise application continuity during infrastructure disruptions.
Enable direct internet access from gateway locations for SaaS and cloud workloads, reducing backhaul requirements and improving cloud application performance.

main: The CloudStation Controller provides intent-driven network policy, centralised orchestration across all edge and gateway devices, and a single management plane for every enterprise location — from a handful of branches to thousands of sites.

The CloudStation Controller is the management brain of the ScaleAOn platform. Every CloudPort Edge and CloudPort Gateway device receives its configuration, policy, and operational directives from the controller — enabling centralised management of any number of enterprise locations from a single interface.
Express network intent through high-level policies. The controller automatically translates policies into device-level configuration across all locations — no per-device manual work required.
Define and enforce network segments to isolate user groups, applications, and data flows across the enterprise. Consistent segmentation from a single policy authority.
Organise sites, users, and devices into logical groups for efficient policy management at scale. Policies applied to a group propagate to every member automatically.
Controller redundancy ensures continuous network management even during infrastructure events. Policy and orchestration remain available without manual failover actions.
Manage multiple enterprise customers or business units from a single controller instance with complete isolation between tenants. Suited for managed service providers and large enterprises.
REST API enables integration with ITSM, SIEM, and other enterprise management platforms. Microsoft Active Directory integration enables identity-aware policies for users and groups.

/products/cloudstation-insights.title: CloudStation Insights — Network Analytics · Lavelle Networks
main: CloudStation Insights collects and analyses telemetry from every device, link, and application across the ScaleAOn network — providing the analytics foundation for operational decisions.
Every CloudPort Edge device and CloudPort Gateway streams continuous telemetry to CloudStation Insights. The platform processes this data to produce Network Scores and historical trend analysis.
Composite scores measuring overall network quality, capacity, and health across every site and the complete enterprise network. A single, consistent view of network performance.
Continuous measurement of packet loss, jitter, latency, and application performance across every WAN link. Quality degradation is detected and reported before users notice an impact.
Track bandwidth utilisation trends across every link and site to identify capacity constraints before they affect users. Capacity planning informed by real operational data.
Deep visibility into application flows, traffic patterns, and endpoint behaviour across the enterprise. Understand exactly what is on the network and how it is using WAN capacity.
Store and analyse historical network performance data for trend identification, capacity planning, and incident investigation. Look back across the full data retention period.
Export raw network telemetry data for custom analysis, reporting, and integration with third-party analytics platforms, SIEM systems, and business intelligence tools.

Measures real-time link quality across packet loss, jitter, and latency dimensions. A low Quality Score triggers dynamic path selection in CloudPort Edge devices to route traffic away from degraded links automatically.

Measures how much of each link's capacity is being consumed relative to its available bandwidth. Consistently high Capacity Scores indicate that an upgrade or traffic optimisation is needed before performance is affected.

A composite score combining quality and capacity trends to give IT teams a single indicator of each link's overall operational health. Enables prioritisation of network improvements across large site portfolios.
Purpose-built hardware with expandable storage for long-term data retention. Sized for large enterprise networks with high telemetry volume.
Deploy on standard server hardware in virtualised environments. Storage can be extended to meet data retention requirements without dedicated hardware.

/products/secure-branch.title: ScaleAOn SD-Branch — Unified Branch Networking · Lavelle Networks
main: Bring SD-WAN, switching and Wi-Fi together into one intelligent branch network, centrally managed and built to adapt as your business changes.

A branch is no longer just employees accessing business applications. It is a connected business edge supporting cloud applications, video collaboration, CCTV, IoT, access control, guest Wi-Fi and always-on digital services. Yet WAN, LAN and Wi-Fi are often still operated as separate networks. That creates complexity everywhere:
Separate networks for corporate, guest, IoT, CCTV and other services
Fragmented policies across WAN, switches and Wi-Fi
Inconsistent application performance across the branch
Multiple devices, configurations and software versions to manage
Infrastructure that is difficult to scale as branch requirements change
Your branch has become one digital
environment. Its network should work like one too.
Bring SD-WAN, Ethernet switching and enterprise Wi-Fi under common management, creating one integrated network from the WAN edge to every connected user and device.
Define access, segmentation and application policies centrally and enforce them consistently across WAN, switching and Wi-Fi.
Prioritise critical applications across the entire branch network, ensuring the traffic that matters gets the performance it needs.
Support corporate access, guest Wi-Fi, IoT, CCTV, access control and collaboration on one infrastructure without building parallel physical networks.
Manage policies, configurations and software versions centrally across branch edge devices, switches and Wi-Fi.
Scale connectivity, capacity and services as branches grow, contract or change purpose, without redesigning the network.
Deploy ScaleAOn SD-WAN, switching and Wi-Fi as an integrated branch network.
Bring users, applications and devices onto a common branch infrastructure, across wired and wireless connectivity.
Apply access, segmentation, application priority and network policies centrally, from WAN edge to endpoint.
Manage every branch centrally with consistent policy, configuration and software control across the enterprise.
Replace fragmented branch networks with one infrastructure across WAN, switching and Wi-Fi.
Open, expand or reconfigure branches without repeatedly redesigning the network underneath them.
Give applications, employees, customers and connected devices the network performance and access they need across every location.
Centrally control policies, configurations and software across distributed branches, reducing operational complexity as the network grows.
One network for every connection, application and service your branch needs today, ready to adapt to what comes next.

main: Warehouses, depots, and distribution centres running on reliable, application-aware connectivity — provisioned quickly and managed centrally.

Warehouses require reliable wireless coverage for handheld scanners, automated picking systems, and WMS terminals. Coverage gaps and wireless degradation halt operations and create inventory discrepancies.

Large logistics networks span regional distribution centres, urban fulfilment hubs, and local depots in a hub-and-spoke topology. Each location type has different connectivity requirements and technical constraints.

Depot locations are often in industrial zones or rural areas where primary broadband quality is variable. Link failures during peak periods — pre-holiday, sale events — have direct operational and financial consequences.
Fleet management and real-time tracking systems require continuous connectivity back to central platforms. Latency and packet loss degrade GPS update frequency and tracking accuracy.

Logistics networks experience sharp demand peaks — seasonal shipping periods, promotional events. Network capacity that is adequate for average demand may be insufficient during peaks, and failures at peak moments have outsized consequences.

Rapid expansion requires the ability to connect new depot locations quickly and without specialist on-site networking expertise. Traditional WAN provisioning timelines — weeks or months — constrain growth velocity.
Hybrid WAN for distribution centres and warehouses

ScaleAOn combines MPLS, broadband, and 4G/LTE transports at each warehouse location. Application-aware routing ensures WMS, ERP, and tracking systems always route over the best available transport. Link quality is measured continuously — not assumed.
Zero-touch provisioning for new depot openings

CloudPort Edge devices ship pre-configured with site identity. On first power-on at a new depot, the device contacts CloudStation Controller, authenticates, and receives its complete configuration automatically. No networking specialist required on-site.
Application prioritisation for WMS and ERP

Warehouse management systems and ERP applications are defined as priority application classes in CloudStation Controller. Policy ensures these applications always receive bandwidth priority over lower-priority traffic — even during peak usage periods.
4G/LTE failover for remote and industrial locations

Depot locations in industrial zones or areas with variable broadband quality are equipped with 4G/LTE as a standby transport. When the primary link degrades below SLA thresholds, ScaleAOn automatically fails over — maintaining operational continuity without manual intervention.

/company/leadership.title: Leadership — Lavelle Networks · Lavelle Networks
main: Lavelle Networks is led by its founders and an experienced leadership team with deep roots in enterprise networking, telecom and technology services. Built from Bangalore, the leadership has spent a decade shaping how Indian enterprises approach connectivity, security, and network operations.

Shyamal Kumar and Drritiman Boraah founded Lavelle Networks in 2015 and both serve on its Board, providing continuity between the Board and the operating organisation across technology, customers and execution.

Shyamal Kumar is the Founder and Chairman of Lavelle Networks, where he guides long-term strategy, product direction and value creation. Over two decades he has built and scaled enterprise and service-provider networking platforms, with leadership roles on the Juniper MX series, the Telsima WiMAX portfolio and Inkra Networks’ virtual services switch.

At Lavelle he led the creation and scale-out of the ScaleAOn SD-WAN platform, which now powers mission-critical networks across financial services, education, e-commerce, logistics and citizen services. He was named Entrepreneur of the Year 2022 and one of the Top 25 Software CEOs in Asia (2020).

Drritiman Boraah co-founded Lavelle Networks, India’s first Software Defined Networking company. He contributes to board-level decisions on strategy, partnerships and growth. Earlier, he worked in quality assurance and product testing at Versa Networks, Juniper Networks, Nokia Siemens Networks, Motorola Solutions, Sasken and Lucent Technologies.
